entities.summary: Julius Davidovich Brutzkus or Judah Loeb Brutzkus or Joselis Bruckus (Hebrew: יהודה ליבּ בֶּן־דָּוִד ברוצקוס, Yehuda Loeb ben David Brutzkus; Russian: Ю́лий Давы́дович Бру́цкус; was a Lithuanian Jewish activist and politician, and one of the leaders of Zionist movement in the Russian Empire.
